svg.title: Proofreader scorer evolution
svg.desc: Fixed-pool proofreader_evolve workflow. Frozen detectors were fitted on 794495, the default TRAIN brain; the default grouped_oof selection protocol ranks TRAIN branches by out-of-fold precision on a detector-naive selection brain (for example 802449) with 794495 as auxiliary fitting data; other eligible prepared brains form fixed development validation. Each generation evolves one merge or split component through formulas or isolated TRAIN-only fit/predict programs; the kind is chosen by pending follow-up, a floor of one revision per four generations, recent gate-passing validation gain and remaining headroom (strict rotation remains available). Tune changes numeric parameters; explore can redesign methods. The default scoring budget is eight shared units plus one execution-error repair. Each classifier configuration costs one unit, including three host-owned fold refits whose out-of-fold score ranks it. Classifier feature diagnostics refit both arms over the same grouped, fragment-purged folds for two units; descriptive formula comparisons cost two. Diagnostic fold models cannot be submitted. Direct 3D analysis is the primary image exploration interface: edit analysis.py and analysis_request.json, then call run_volume_analysis. Eight executions of up to four TRAIN cases use a separate budget. The sandbox supplies original voxels, validity masks, physical spacing, anchors and aligned bounded fragments; OME metadata maps fragment xyz microns to patch zyx voxel centers. Optional MIP/slab tools have a separate allowance. Save code, input identities, results and IO timings. Analysis does not establish ranking gain; implement and measure a feature or frozen model. Image investigation selections and scoring coverage are independent. With --context-cache, the host caches the raw context of the detector-ranked band once per brain and kind (fragment neighbourhoods at 50 um plus level-1 and level-0 image patches, both for the whole band since 2026-10-05); the agent edits descriptor.py and calls plan_descriptor_run and compute_descriptors to measure its own quantities over every cached TRAIN row in parallel sandboxed workers. Results register as bank_agent_* predictors with label-conditional TRAIN quartiles, cost one unit per uncached call within wall budgets, are cached by code hash in descriptor_bank/, and are recomputed by the host on validation brains at submission; descriptors.json records them for resume. Nothing in the cache is a feature. Retain at most five TRAIN branches per kind plus a protected accepted reference. A new promotion gets the next same-kind explore slot for fresh branch evidence, with at most one retry. Seeds and identical references do not enqueue follow-ups. Otherwise explore the reference every third scheduled kind round. Performance plateaus or two rounds without fresh evidence require a new paired TRAIN ablation or numerical 3D comparison on two distinct candidates. Prioritize registered image evidence when images have not been compared. Negative measurements count; plans, previews and cached restores do not complete the investigation. Combined assignments must measure the comparison on the promoted branch. Incomplete assignments skip validation and retain the accepted policy. Default bounded pauses distinguish incomplete investigations, consecutive execution blocks and measured stagnation. Execution failure is not scientific rejection. A completed assignment with a measured submission receives frozen evaluation on every validation brain regardless of TRAIN gain. Average merge/split Precision at K within each brain, then average brains equally; promote when the mean improves beyond the margin and the lower bound of the paired bootstrap interval of that gain is above zero (default gate; the margin-only rule remains available). Validation inspection and labels remain hidden; frozen inference can use registered validation pixels. Selection provides indirect validation feedback: this is development validation, not an untouched final test. Save scorer/model artifacts, evidence receipts, branch ancestry, coverage, trajectories, costs and alignment provenance.
svg.text: Proofreader scorer evolution
Improve Precision@K through measured TRAIN experiments on immutable detector-native candidates
FROZEN
pool · base features · labels · K
EDITABLE
scorer · training · descriptor · analysis · proposal · rules
EVALUATION
TRAIN exploration → mean validation gate
PREPARE ONCE, THEN INITIALIZE · no LLM calls
Optional context cache: band fragment neighbourhoods + level-1 / level-0 patches for the whole band, built once per brain (--extend-tier grows a tier)

g.text: TRAIN labels → fit; IDs stay in evaluator
Fixed K + pools; registered xyz/zyx; hash inputs + models
Record exclusions; freeze eligible disjoint splits

svg.text: Seed scorer becomes the initial accepted parent
WITHIN EACH GENERATION · fresh LLM session
OUTER EVALUATOR · after the LLM session ends

g.text: Edit one kind; harness freezes the other

svg.text: tool call

g.text: Fold refits → OOF score → full-TRAIN fit
Separate image coverage from image-only gain

svg.text: submit

g.text: Mean P@K up beyond bootstrap noise
No validation data or scores sent to the LLM

svg.text: decision

g.text: Mean gain clears noise → replace parent
Next kind: follow-up · floor · gain · headroom
All kinds paused → stop; keep accepted scorer

svg.text: TRAIN results → revise within the attempt budget
Formula path: evaluate_train / search_parameters · model path: train_classifier
evaluate_feature_ablation (TRAIN-only, advisory) · compute_descriptors: pilot / boundary / all_cached
Invalid / evaluation failure → keep parent
Same fixed K and native pools · gain above margin with bootstrap lower bound > 0
Verify new evidence after stalls; prioritize promoted branches; bound incomplete and failed retries

g.text: Other eligible brains are development validation: hidden from the LLM; their mean selects the accepted scorer.
Selection provides indirect feedback across generations. An untouched final test requires a separate brain.
Keep all three together to resume models
Training code, parameters, file hashes and outcomes
3D analyses · ablations · descriptor runs (bank by code hash)
Offline branches, attempts, diffs, metrics and errors
Human-only validation reports + alignment / IO evidence

svg.text: Scope: sparse native-label ranking. Graph repair efficacy requires separate evaluation; candidate pools, detector weights and K remain fixed.
CLI defaults: TRAIN 794495 · grouped_oof · bootstrap mean gate (1000 draws) · MCL 100 · K = 100 · 15 generations · recommended: TRAIN 794495,802449 · K = 2000 · --context-cache
